scientific_integrity: Exact infinite-family proof with independent finite-dimensional numerical corroboration; the numerical checks alone do not establish the theorem. Known single-trap projection and capture formulas are acknowledged as prior work.
scientific_limitations: Single-excitation, homogeneous-coherent binary hypercube, exactly two distinct absorbing sites of strictly positive rates. Eventual capture only, not finite-time capture, disordered couplings, dephasing, or interacting particles. Novelty assessed only against inspected primary sources and searched public indexes; independent scientific audit not performed.
title: The antipodal redundancy theorem for two lossy sites on a quantum hypercube
